title: Angular velocity ratio
description: Essential: The final ratio ω_A:ω_B must be correctly calculated as 8:1 (or equivalent).

title: Centripetal acceleration ratio
description: Essential: The final ratio a_A:a_B must be correctly calculated as 16:1 (or equivalent).

title: Apply ω = 2π/T
description: Important: The relationship ω = 2π/T must be used to connect angular velocity to the given periods.

title: Apply Kepler's Third Law
description: Important: Kepler's Third Law (r³ ∝ T²) must be used to find the ratio of orbital radii.

title: Combine for acceleration
description: Important: The formula a = ω²r must be correctly combined with the ratios for ω and r to find a_A/a_B.

title: Correct exponent handling
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for algebraic errors in simplifying (T_B/T_A)² * (T_A/T_B)^(2/3) to (T_B/T_A)^(4/3).

title: Unit or ratio format
description: Optional: The answer is presented as a simplified ratio (e.g., 8:1) without extraneous units or factors of π.
